sources.topic: Pane requests, language selection, screen/window layout, cursor/scroll policies and WD endpoints

contract.service: Explicit headless PendantDisplay; no desktop/browser/network opening
contract.requests: Pane 1..9 opaque printable locations, positive portable SPI/SCR IDs, configured STRING language labels
contract.surfaces: Bounded printable ASCII grids, one-based attachments, overlay order and render() composition; 64 screens/windows, configurable cell budget
contract.file: WD:name text output; common or per-handle cursors, deferred wrap, optional bottom scrolling, LF/CR/FF/BS/TAB; logical bytes written
contract.statuses: Portable 0..5; documented activation 9093 and unavailable-language 33003 cases; typed disjoint outputs and preflighted capacity
contract.history: Bounded accepted request rows with finite sequence and root owner; FILE writes retain byte counts; sequence exhaustion still permits close
contract.persistence: Closed-handle logical data and shared cursors only; no reopening, automatic replay or source task checkpoint

boundaries: No keyboard association/input, READ, binary/XML, byte seeking or input availability on window handles
No native UI/glyph/style rendering, dynamic controls, dictionaries or language packs
No native menu/option encodings, abort-time screen restoration or controller validation; strict mode deferred
